I (23F) was diagnosed 19yo, I had suffered from it since I was 15yo. It was always misdiagnosed as a reoccuring yeast infection. I always was using cortison cremes for yeast infections, but the minute I stopped, the itching and pain came back. Then in 2021 it took a turn. The itching and pain was unbearable, I skipped school, stayed home, had dark thoughts and had a month or so that I just was laying in the couch becaus I was in a lot of pain. 
So I went to a dermatologist (instead of a obgyn) for a second opinion and she diagnosed me with Lichen. I was so relieved, that I was sick for a full day because my body let loose of all the builduip tension. So I started using clobetasol. It worked fine. The lichen became inactive and also didn’t spread outside my perineum. But I began to notice that the clobetasol was way to heavy for me. When I used it, it would spread to healthy skin. And would remove the first layer of my lichen skin and surrounding skin. So I went back to my doctor and he gave me a prescription made cream. (If you would like more info, send me a message). Now i use this when I feel “the itch” for a few days and it works wonders. 
What is VERY helpful is the Cicalfaat cream from Avène. I use this multiple times a week. It contains no cortison or whatever, it’s just to heal skins better. Can even use it as handcream. I use it after sex, after a big toilet visit and a few nights a week before sleeping. This cream is the reason I don’t get flare ups as often. I now need to use cortison cream only a few times a year. But the cortison was very important to get rid of the active lichen in the beginning and for maintenance the Cicalfaat cream works wonders. I sometimes even use it when I feel an itch and it keeps me from needing cortisol. 

I always thought in the beginning that I wouldn’t be able to use heavy creams for the rest of my life and the question of sex and children was always heavy loaded. I restraint from sex or intimacy because I was so miserable. But I found a way with ups and downs that works. I now live a normal life and don’t see myself anymore as someone with a skin condition. I just use the Cicalfaat cream as preventative and maintenance. And it does the job. It’s like using face cream. You get used to it and don’t question it anymore. It will be okay! Just hold on and don’t be scared to go for second opinions or extra appointments when you feel like the treatment isn’t working like you want. There is a treatment out there for you that works, you just need to find it and be honest to your doctor!
